product_metadata.title: EIGRAMSET Christmas Throw Pillow Covers (Set of 2) 18 x 18 - Snowman Pillow Cases, Throw Pillow Decor, Holiday Season Decorations for Winter Couch Cushions,Red
features: 2 PACK CHRISTMAS THROW PILLOW CUSHION COVERS: Set of two 18" x 18" unique Christmas-themed cushion covers. Slip covers are hypoallergenic and contain no filling or stuffing inside. They are designed to stuff or slip over your own home decor pillows.

VIBRANT & MACHINE WASHABLE: These decorative pillows feature a snowman holding a red cardnal bird are machine washable. They are made of sturdy fabric and will not fade or ball due to wash or use. Ideal for the cushions on your sofa, bench, couch, bed & chairs.
DIMENSIONS: 18 x 18 Inches (45 x 45cm) . You get two matching pillow covers that feature a decorative holiday scene featuring a festive snowman (as pictured) with a dark red back (as pictured).

PROTECT YOUR PILLOWS & ADD HOLIDAY CHEER: Now you can protect your pillows during the holiday season from food & wine spills! These pillow covers feature a hidden zipper so that you can easily slip them on & off to wash as needed & easily store.
description: The aim of EIGRAMSET is to offer many high quality products to customers and satisfy the needs of all customers. To achieve this, EIGRAMSET will spend more time to design the products.
